findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_passport_renewal, get_country · Private data: get_recent_changes, get_about, get_passport_renewal, get_malta_citizen_service, get_document_checklist, plan_path, get_family_pathway, get_name_change, get_foundation_rules, get_nonresident_banking, build_sow_pack, search_properties · Public sink: book_consultation, generate_briefing, subscribe_changes, get_emigration_flows, choice_of_law_options, create_enquiry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_passport_renewal, get_country · Private data: get_recent_changes, get_about, get_passport_renewal, get_malta_citizen_service, get_document_checklist, plan_path, get_family_pathway, get_name_change, get_foundation_rules, get_nonresident_banking, build_sow_pack, search_properties · Public sink: book_consultation, generate_briefing, subscribe_changes, get_emigration_flows, choice_of_law_options, create_enquiry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
